evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Medial meniscus: There is mild blunting/fraying of the inner margin of the medial meniscus without tear.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: There is partial thickness, in part delaminating cartilage fissuring (grade 3 chondral fissuring) at the central weightbearing aspect of the lateral femoral condyle (se 8, img 8 to 12). Very small marginal osteophytes.
evidence.PF OA: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is a chronic, 15 x 15 mm full-thickness cartilage defect (grade 4 chondral defect) at the groove of the femoral trochlea extending into the lateral aspect of the trochlea with subchondral cystic change.
evidence.Effusion: There is a moderate joint effusion.
evidence.Contusion: There is a moderate, diffuse bone contusion involving the most anterior aspect of the medial femoral condyle and a mild, small contusion at the most anterior aspect of the lateral femoral condyle.
